summary: Owner authorises private, non-commercial storage of eligible daily market observations and the BOT reference FX series on owner-controlled hardware, plus display/calculation/derived use of the BOT reference FX. The right is conditional and time-bounded: private warehouse only, no redistribution, no public derived benchmark, no model training, and purge within 30 days of the applicable terms or plan ending. Owner authorisation is not a substitute for the vendor's own licence.
owner_decision_text: The Owner approved recording an Owner Approval for private storage and research use, explicitly not UNLIMITED_RETENTION, subject to plan/provider limits, private-only storage, no publication, purge after rights end (about 30 days), and separation from index/product/public distribution.

caveats: Web search results and cached copies show different revisions; the effective revision for this account must be confirmed by the Owner against the signed-in terms page.
Third-party data-provider restrictions and exchange terms continue to apply and are not overridden by the Owner's authorisation.
Rights end with the subscription/plan; the storage right is not perpetual.

permitted_content: daily OHLCV aggregates for the held universe and required benchmarks
derived research outputs (returns, coverage, proposals) without raw prices in public artifacts

not_authorized: public redistribution of raw or derived market data
publishing a public derived benchmark or index
AI model training on vendor data
claiming BOT reference FX as an executable brokerage rate
activation_prerequisites: Massive: credential present, live historical-bar response observed (V98), storage gate reads this record
BOT: contract verified against live responses (2026-11-04) and credential present
Both: purge path available and documented before any partition is written
notes: This amendment grants no trading, transfer or publication right.
If the vendor terms, plan or third-party restrictions change, collection must stop and the purge command must be run.
Raw provider responses are not retained; only parsed daily bars and reference FX points are stored.
